title: Argentinian Chorizo Empanadas
description: A classic Argentinian dish featuring chorizo sausage wrapped in crispy empanada dough.
instructions: Roll out empanada dough to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a few slices of chorizo in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-circle, pressing edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with water and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Place empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve warm.
